slides.title: Security company owners: when a client asks if every guard's license is current, here's exactly what to say:

slides.label: Say this
slides.title: "I'll send you the current roster with license expiration dates today."

slides.label: Then do this
slides.title: Actually check every date before you hit send.
slides.body: Including the guy you hired in a rush for the Black Friday shift.

slides.label: If one lapsed
slides.title: "One renewal is in process. I'm swapping in a guard with a current license for that post."
slides.body: Honest beats a surprise at the gate.

slides.label: And this
slides.title: "Want our updated insurance certificate with that?"
slides.body: Event clients often ask for it next anyway.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: For the next 4:55 PM Friday email that says "quick question."
